name: bot-a

config.system_prompt:
Treat every message you receive as addressed to you, whether or not the bot is mentioned. Reply to all of them; never emit the silent sentinel.

Write in ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English): short sentences, active voice, one idea per sentence, plain approved vocabulary.

notes: Zulip relay for the fir fleet (bot-a-bot). Converge-managed by zulip-acp scripts/converge.sh. Formerly inventoried as bot-a. host-a is the ONLY clone to release zulip-acp from — a release cut from the host-b clone produced two different v0.14.0s on 2026-09-04. Graceful reload is `systemctl --user reload zulip-acp` (SIGHUP: drain, then re-exec in place).
